[suggestion] Can you simplify the code like this?

```suggestion
	return nodes.some((node) => isFunctionNode(node) && checkFunctionForTypeMix(node));
```

[suggestion] Thanks for adding test cases in the second `testRule()`. The coverage has been much improved. 👍🏼 

In addition, if you don't have any special reason, can you merge the second `testRule()` into the existing first `testRule()`? 🙏🏼 
The two `testRule()` with the same `config: true` might confuse maintainers in the future.

comments.body:
[question] Is this check for `var()` and `env()` necessary? 
`containsOnlyEnvFunction()` seems to check beforehand.

[suggestion] Can you simplify the code like this?

```suggestion
	return nodes.some((node) => isFunctionNode(node) && checkFunctionForTypeMix(node));
```

[suggestion] The `node` property seems unused. Can we simplify the `operands` array?

```suggestion
		/** @type {Array<'number' | 'dimension' | 'percentage' | 'other'>} */
```

```suggestion
Fixed: `declaration-property-value-no-unknown` false negatives for math functions
```

Would be more inline with how we've described this type of change in other rules.

```suggestion
		`Unexpected invalid math expression "${expression}" for property "${property}"`,
```

For consistency with [our conventions](https://stylelint.io/developer-guide/rules#add-problem-messages).
